title: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
shortDescription: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc helps define a Nintendo Switch action and adventure and visual novel path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference action and adventure and visual novel marker within the Nintendo Switch catalog.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Nintendo Switch action and adventure and visual novel discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a deterministic catalog-method entry rather than a provider verdict.
